items.title: Commission calls on 10 Member States to comply with the Data Governance Act
items.title_zh: 欧委会要求 10 个成员国遵守《数据治理法》
items.summary: The Commission moved Czechia, Germany, Estonia, Greece, Cyprus, Luxembourg, Austria, Poland, Portugal and Slovenia to the reasoned-opinion stage.
items.summary_zh: 欧委会将捷克、德国、爱沙尼亚、希腊、塞浦路斯、卢森堡、奥地利、波兰、葡萄牙和斯洛文尼亚推进至 reasoned opinion 阶段。

items.title: Commission calls on 18 Member States to comply with the Data Governance Act
items.title_zh: 欧委会要求 18 个成员国指定《数据治理法》主管机关
items.summary: The Commission opened formal infringement procedures over the designation or empowerment of national DGA authorities.
items.summary_zh: 欧委会因成员国主管机关指定或授权问题，对 18 个成员国启动 formal notice 程序。

items.title: Commission calls on Ireland to comply with the Data Governance Act
items.title_zh: 欧委会要求爱尔兰遵守《数据治理法》
items.summary: Ireland received a formal notice concerning the designation of competent authorities under the DGA.
items.summary_zh: 爱尔兰因 DGA 主管机关指定问题收到 formal notice。
